task_description: Add keyboard-driven photo selection workflow with export destination prompt to GroupingScreen

patterns.state_notifier_pattern: StateNotifier<T> with Ref for accessing other providers via _ref.read()
patterns.widget_pattern: ConsumerStatefulWidget with initState for local state like cursor position
patterns.selection_pattern: toggleSelection(id) uses copyWith to update isSelected flag immutably
patterns.group_creation_pattern: createGroupFromSelection() reads selectedImagesProvider, creates group, then marks images as grouped
patterns.directory_picker_pattern: FilePicker.platform.getDirectoryPath() returns String? (null on web or cancel)

edge_cases: Cursor at end of list - clamp to valid range
Empty ungrouped images list - disable keyboard navigation
No groups to undo - do nothing gracefully
User cancels directory picker - allow continuing (re-prompt at export)
Web platform - skip directory picker (uses browser download)
